method: Conservative visual transcription of legible printed curb bars. Fractions are approximate positions along the named block, west to east for horizontal streets and north to south for vertical streets. The purple resident-eligibility fill is ignored. This is a partial inventory; omitted bars were too ambiguous to place safely.

rules.pay-split: Pay parking except with permit 09:00-17:00; permit parking only 17:00-09:00
